text:
noah: quick thread 4dd about the new compact action pattern on dashboard tiles. i prototyped a variant where action buttons sit tighter and the toast container shifts to avoid overlap. need alignment before i change tokens.

mei: can you summarize the token delta? numbers please, PM wants a single change to land.

noah: sure 11. current gap: `--space-3` (12px). proposal: `--space-2` (8px) for intra-action gap; keep `--space-3` around the tile edge. add `--action-compact` boolean for docs.

chan: i'm nervous about very short labels + compact gap. icon+label buttons could feel squashed. can we make a `button--compact` modifier that reduces horizontal padding but keeps min-width and 44px height?

noah: exactly. plan: `.btn--compact { padding: 0 calc(var(--space-2) - 2px); min-width:72px; }` icon-only uses `.btn--icon { width:40px; height:40px }` but we prefer 44x44 for touch.

ravi: accessibility: if we shrink spacing, ensure focus ring doesn't overlap neighbors. use `outline-offset:3px` and `--color-focus-contrast` token. also verify :focus-visible for keyboard users only.

mei: what about DOM order when actions wrap on narrow screens? last sprint we had issues when we used `order` to push primary left.

chan: keep DOM order stable. visual-only reordering via transforms caused screen reader sequence mismatches. propose using `flex-wrap:wrap` and allow natural flow, primary button first in DOM.

noah: agreed. add test: keyboard tab through actions after wrap, ensure primary is first in tab sequence. i'll add to the component test page.

mei: toasts 514: current placement bottom-right collides with right-rail CTAs on narrow widths. options? move to top-right or top-center on wide dashboards. latest idea: top-right offset by `--space-4`, switch to bottom-center full-width on mobile.

ravi: prefer newest-on-top for toasts. assistive tech tends to prefer newest announcements; use `aria-live:polite` for non-critical, and `role=alert` for errors (persistent). auto-dismiss 5s info, 10s warning.

chan: add `pointer-events:none` to the toast container and `pointer-events:auto` to individual toasts to prevent clicks falling through. also set high z-index but keep below global modals. suggestion: `z-index: calc(--z-modal - 10)`.

noah: good call. also motion: animate opacity + translateY for entrance to avoid layout shift. keep reduced motion preference honored: if `prefers-reduced-motion` reduce to fade-only.

mei: copy nit: dismiss button on toasts should read `Dismiss` for consistency. also keep sentence case for action labels.

ravi: add screen reader test: trigger two toasts within 300ms, ensure only the newest is announced. NVDA/VoiceOver verification required. also Esc to dismiss and restore focus to triggering control.

chan: small CSS snippet for reference:```css
.toast-container { position: fixed; top: 16px; right: var(--space-4); display:flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--toast-gap, var(--space-2)); pointer-events: none; }
.toast { pointer-events:auto; transform: translateY(-6px); transition: transform .18s ease, opacity .18s ease; }
```

noah: thanks folks. i'll update the tokens PR to change intra-action gap to `--space-2`, add `--toast-gap`, and include the accessibility checklist. i'll also add visual examples for dense table rows, right-rail cards, and mobile wrap.

mei: i'll run the QA + PM review. if a11y signoff from ravi, we can freeze for the sprint.

ravi: i'll run NVDA + VoiceOver tests tonight and post results. adding checklist item: focus ring contrast, DOM order stability, toast announce behavior, Esc restore focus.

a11y-checker: preview link: https://deploy-preview.redwood/design/compact-actions-1945678901 (visual diffs + token changes).

noah: awesome, thanks everyone 64f i'll open the PR and mark it ready for review.
